The renderer also accepts skill.teach / item.teach; if those are missing, academy-session-lesson.mjs falls back here, then to a built-in source-type lesson.

teach.fnd-orient-source-type: Jewish texts come in a few basic kinds, and you can often tell which one you are looking at from its shape — before you translate every word. A Torah verse usually tells or commands in the Bible’s own voice. A Mishnah states a compact rule; the Gemara then asks about that rule and argues it. Commentary talks about the text from the side, rather than being the text itself.
